conclusion: The 30-cell FULL16 frame carries 120 raw bits, of which 88 are payload (11 bytes). At 60 display frames/s the raw rate is 7200 bps, the framed payload rate is 5280 bps, and the RS(255,223) goodput is 4617 bps. A packet occupies 4.25 s at 60 fps and the 4-bit packet id caps a transfer at 16 packets (39216 bytes before compression). These are THEORETICAL arithmetic values; software timings are OBSERVED on the run machine.
title: Protocol arithmetic and raw capacity
